preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must contain only alphanumeric characters.

postconditions.description: The output string must contain only alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == sum(int(s[i]) * (1 if s[i-1].isalpha() else 0) for i in range(1, len(s)) if s[i].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The length of the output string must match the total number of characters expanded from the input string.
If the input string is empty, the output must also be an empty string.
